meta.name: study-feynman
meta.description: Feynman-technique verification sub-skill (orchestrated by study-assistant; also usable standalone). Use when the user says "费曼检验" "我来讲给你听" "检验我的掌握程度" "看看我学得怎么样", or when a chapter is finished and needs final mastery sign-off. The learner explains a point in their own words; Codex plays a sharp beginner, probes gaps, scores mastery 1-5, and writes mastery reports.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用费曼技巧检验并巩固学习成果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果学习后想用费曼技巧检验自己的掌握程度
copy.tagline_en: Test and reinforce learning with the Feynman technique
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to verify your understanding using the Feynman technique after studying

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会扮演一个严格的初学者，让你用自己的话讲解知识点，然后通过追问找出你的理解漏洞，最后给出1-5分的掌握度评分和改进建议。
howto.when: 当你说出“费曼检验”、“我来讲给你听”、“检验我的掌握程度”、“看看我学得怎么样”等关键词，或者学完一章需要确认掌握程度时触发。

say.text: 费曼检验：请帮我检验我对“牛顿第二定律”的掌握程度。
say.note: Claude 会要求你讲解该知识点，然后追问并评分。

say.text: 我来讲给你听：什么是光合作用？
say.note: Claude 会扮演初学者，听完后指出你的漏洞。

say.text: 看看我学得怎么样，关于“勾股定理”。
say.note: Claude 会启动费曼检验流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a sharp beginner: you explain a concept in your own words, then Claude probes gaps with questions, scores mastery 1-5, and gives feedback.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords like "费曼检验", "我来讲给你听", "检验我的掌握程度", "看看我学得怎么样", or when a chapter is finished and needs mastery sign-off.

say_en.text: Feynman check: test my understanding of Newton's second law.
say_en.note: Claude will ask you to explain and then probe.

say_en.text: Let me explain: what is photosynthesis?
say_en.note: Claude plays beginner and points out gaps.

say_en.text: Check how well I learned the Pythagorean theorem.
say_en.note: Claude starts the Feynman verification process.
